2.Drying Recommendations
Dry before use to ensure the best print quality and consistent finish. Store in a dry environment after use. For more details, please refer to: Filament drying instructions on WIKI.
3.Refill Guidelines
The refill filament needs to be used with a spool. For detailed instructions on how to swap in the new filament using the Bambu Reusable Spool, please refer to the guide on WIKI.
4.Safety Tips
Please store the filament in a cool, dark, and dry environment away from direct sunlight and high temperatures.
Please keep filament and any broken fragments out of reach of infants, children, and pets to prevent swallowing or choking.

strings.en: PEI is an excellent material for 3D printing applications due to its ability to withstand the repeated heating and cooling cycles of a printer heatbed. Prints come off easily when the temperature of the heatbed reaches room temperature, and we always recommend waiting until it reaches 35℃ or lower. If the print still adheres to the plate, simply bend the steel plate and the model will fall right into your hands.
Reliable Magnetic Adhesion to Prevent Warping

context.title: Bambu Textured PEI Plate
context.near: The Bambu Texture PEI Plate features a 0.5mm-thick stainless steel plate that enhances magnetic adhesion. This helps to prevent warping and ensure optimal print

strings.en: The Bambu Texture PEI Plate features a 0.5mm-thick stainless steel plate that enhances magnetic adhesion. This helps to prevent warping and ensure optimal print quality during 3D printing, reducing the likelihood of the first layer detaching due to deformation. It also helps when printing larger models with materials that are prone to warping like ABS, PC and Nylon.

strings.en: Increasing heatbed temperature enhances adhesion. Users need to adjust the temperature of the heatbed based on their specific requirements in order to achieve the most suitable level of adhesion.

Before auto-leveling, it is necessary to repeatedly rub the nozzle in the special wiping area of the build plate to completely remove any residual material at the tip of the nozzle. The coating in the special-designed wiping area will gradually become worn over time. This is normal and does not affect print quality or nozzle lifetime, so there is no need to worry about any quality issues.

The AMS 2 Pro Feeder Unit is specially designed to support the AMS 2 Pro for printing multiple colors and materials. Ceramic-reinforced antiwear bushings are embedded in each feeder inlet to better protect the inlet from being worn by the filament after prolonged use. Each AMS 2 Pro has 4 feeder units, and each feeder unit has its own motor and gears to actively push the filament forward or wind it back to the spool.The AMS 2 Pro Feeder Unit has a sensor to detect filament. When a filament is inserted, the feeder unit will feed the filament automatically. When a filament needs to be wound back, the feeder unit will drive the AMS 2 Pro active support shaft to rotate the spool for filament winding.
Recommended tools for installation: PH Screwdriver, Transparent Adhesive, Wire Cutter, Needle Nose Side-Cutter, Tweezer, Glue.

The all-new AMS lite is elegant and reliable, making multi-color 3D printing accessible to everyone.

The A1 mini revolutionizes flow control in 3D printing. It utilizes a high-resolution, high-frequency eddy current sensor to measure the pressure in the nozzle. Our algorithm actively compensates the flow rate according to the readings to extrude with accuracy.
The A1 mini handles various calibrations all by itself. It meticulously calibrates the Z-offset, bed-level, vibration resonance and nozzle pressure for EVERY print job, automatically.
The A1 mini comes to you pre-assembled, pre-squared, and pre-tuned with precision. It only takes about 20 minutes to set up for your first print.
The A1 mini can calibrate parameters to match tiny individual differences between each drive motor. This compensates for the unwanted harshness of motor noise.

strings.en: 2. Can a non-laser H2S be upgraded to a laser H2S?

Yes. The upgrade kit and its installation guide will be available some time after the product launch. Note that the upgrade kit uses an external air pump, which differs in installation structure from the built-in air pump. It must be installed externally and connected to the machine via an air tube. The upgraded printer has the same functionality and processing performance as the laser version.

4. Is the H2S compatible with the first-generation AMS or AMS lite?

The first-generation AMS is fully plug-and-play compatible with the H2S for multi-color printing but does not support AMS drying. Due to fundamental differences in the feeding mechanism and buffer structure, the H2S does not support AMS lite.

strings.en: 5. How many AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT units can the H2S support, and how many colors can it print?
The H2S supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro and 8 AMS HT units, totaling 12 units with 24 filament slots, enabling up to 24-color printing.

strings.en: 6. Are the hotend and silicone sock of the H2S compatible with the H2D or A1?

The H2S hotend and silicone sock are compatible with the H2D. While structurally similar to the A1 hotend, they are not fully compatible. For optimal print quality, we strongly recommend not using the A1 hotend on H2 series printers. Using an H2 series hotend on an A1 printer is feasible, but it requires the H2 series silicone sock.

strings.en: 7. Are the H2S and A1 series tool heads the same? Can the components on the tool head be shared with the A1 series?

The H2S tool head features a completely new design, with optimized and upgraded components, including the extruder motor, filament drive wheel, hotend heating assembly, and cooling fan. As a result, the components on the H2S tool head are not compatible with the A1 series, except for the cutter blade.

strings.en: The Vortek system can store filament information in the hotend’s memory, ensuring the correct filament is matched to each hotend. If you are printing with more than seven filament types, the system can calculate the optimal combination to minimize purge waste.
Why Vortek?
Small Form Factor, More Filaments

Because only the hotend is swapped, the system can house up to six replaceable hotends without significantly reducing the build volume.That means more materials, more colors, and more possibilities — all in one print.

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: A Bed-Slinger As Stable As CoreXY

strings.en: A model gets taller. It gets heavier. The way the machine vibrates changes with it. Most printers run input shaping once at startup and call it done. The A2L runs Adaptive Vibration Compensation—a real-time calibration matrix that factors in both toolhead position and shifting bed load, retuning the resonance model layer by layer as the print grows. The last layer comes out as clean as the first.

Software handles the vibration it can predict. Hardware handles the rest. Inside the A2L's gantry sit two Granular Dampers—sealed chambers packed with fine particles that dissipate vibration through countless micro-collisions. It's a damping technique borrowed from aerospace and precision machinery, rarely seen in desktop 3D printers. The result: surface ripples and ghost lines stay out of your prints, even at full build height.

strings.en: 3. Why doesn't the A2L feature dual-nozzle or multi-toolhead technology?

The A2L is positioned to provide an ultra-pure, simple, and easy-to-use large-format printing experience. Therefore, we prioritized optimizing core performance—such as build volume, surface quality, and reliability.

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 3. Why doesn't the A2L feature dual-nozzle or multi-toolhead technology?

strings.en: 4. How is the noise level during normal printing?

The A2L delivers exceptional silent performance. In Silent Mode, noise levels stay below 49 dB (comparable to a quiet library whisper). In Standard Mode, peak noise is approximately 52 dB. (Data source: Bambu Lab internal testing)

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 4. How is the noise level during normal printing?

strings.en: 5. Why is the maximum bed temperature lower than that of A1?

As an open-frame printer, the A2L is primarily designed for non-engineering filaments like PLA and PETG, which have lower bed temperature requirements. Due to the significantly larger surface area, maintaining extreme temperatures would consume excessive power. To prevent overloading home electrical circuits, we set the maximum temperature to 80°C. This strategy perfectly supports mainstream filaments while achieving a more reasonable energy consumption.

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 5. Why is the maximum bed temperature lower than that of A1?

strings.en: 6.What intelligent detection features does the A2L include?

The A2L introduces a PMSM closed-loop servo extruder and a physical "blob" (nozzle clumping) detector, providing more precise extrusion monitoring and reliable protection against filament buildup. Additionally, it inherits the highly acclaimed detection suite from the A1 series, including Filament Run-out, Nozzle Clogging (Air Printing), and Tangled Spool detection.

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 6.What intelligent detection features does the A2L include?

strings.en: 7.How many AMS units can be connected to the A2L?

The A2L is highly expandable, supporting up to 4 box-style AMS units and 1 AMS lite connected in series, enabling up to 19-color printing. (Connecting the box-style AMS uses up one buffer path, so one AMS lite slot will be unavailable.) More details please check.

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 7.How many AMS units can be connected to the A2L?

strings.en: 8.Does using the AMS drying function on the A2L require an external power supply?
Yes. Due to the power distribution logic of the A2L, the AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT drying functions require a connection to an external independent power source via a power cable or power supply.

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 8.Does using the AMS drying function on the A2L require an external power supply?

strings.en: 9.Does the A2L support laser or blade-cutting modules?

For safety reasons related to its open-frame design, the A2L does not support laser modules. However, the modular mounting point allows for a blade-cutting module for precision cutting and pen-plotting functions.

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 9.Does the A2L support laser or blade-cutting modules?

strings.en: 10.What accessories are needed to use the 2D processing features?

You only need to purchase the "Blade Cutting Upgrade Kit," which includes the cutting module, a pen module, a dedicated cutting mat, and related accessories. (You can also get materials for 2D processing in Bambu Store)

context.title: Bambu Lab A2L
context.near: 10.What accessories are needed to use the 2D processing features?

strings.en: 11.Is the blade-cutting functionality on the A2L identical to the H2 series?

The A2L does not have a BirdsEye camera, so it cannot perform the fully automatic Live Spatial Alignment found on the H2 series Laser versions. However, users can use Bambu Handy with their smartphone camera for photo-assisted alignment. The "Print-then-Cut" feature is currently under development and may be released in a future OTA firmware update.

5.Warping Prevention Tips

ABS is prone to warping when printing a large size and/or high infill density model. To avoid warping: 1) Not recommended to print too large size and/or high infill density model. 2) Use enclosure printers and ensure the build plate is properly glued before printing. 3) Set lower printing speed and higher heatbed temperature. 6.Safety Tips

We recommend using an enclosed printer. At printing temperatures, this filament may release harmful gases, including styrene, which can cause dizziness or nausea. For extended operation, please wear a protective mask with a vapor filter (such as an activated carbon mask). If individuals with asthma or respiratory conditions, pregnant women, or children are present, please increase ventilation or pause printing with this material.

Bambu PETG-CF is a carbon fiber reinforced PETG that offers improved performance and appearance compared to traditional PETG. The specially formulated blend minimizes the risk of warping and nozzle sticking, while still providing a smooth and consistent print quality. Addition of carbon fiber brings distinctive texture and improved strength to the material, making it ideal for high-stress models requiring premium finish. Whether you're an engineer looking to create functional prototypes, an artist looking to create high-quality models, or simply an enthusiast looking to experiment with the latest materials, Bambu PETG-CF is the ideal choice.

Thanks to its enhanced resistance to heat and moisture, Bambu PETG-CF is ideal for outdoor applications. Feel free to create durable tools for your garden or any outdoor environment.
Bambu PETG-CF features a carbon fiber texture that conceals layer lines, while its surface finish is glossier than that of PLA-CF, making it as attractive as it is functional.

For stronger Z-axis adhesion, increase the infill density. Avoid using an open-frame printer and refrain from setting the cooling fan speed too high, as overcooling can weaken layer bonding.

With a default printing speed that is twice as fast as standard PETG filaments, PETG HF takes your printing efficiency to new heights. It effectively addresses common issues such as oozing and clumping associated with regular PETG, ensuring smoother and more reliable prints. The new matte finish not only enhances the aesthetic by smoothing out uneven gloss during speed transitions but also provides a consistently uniform look. Offering greater durability and toughness than PLA, PETG HF is the ideal choice for creating long-lasting items with an improved finish and faster production times.

PPA-CF offers strength approaching metal levels, being 48% stronger and 102% stiffer than normal PA6-CF. This filament excels in mechanical properties, making it ideal for high-performance engineering applications. Perfect for repairs, it can effectively replace automotive and industrial parts with exceptional durability and reliability.

Achieve industrial-grade precision with Bambu PPA-CF. Its superior dimensional stability ensures that your high-precision prototypes match your design drawings exactly, without warping or deformation. Rely on PPA-CF for the accuracy you need in every project.

Bambu PPA-CF supports long-term, stable use in humid environments, even underwater. With a moisture absorption rate 66% lower than normal PA6-CF, it maintains its stiffness and thermal properties over time. Whether printing propellers, customizing surfboards, or any other water-resistant application, PPA-CF delivers reliable performance.

Bambu PPA-CF boasts unmatched heat resistance, capable of withstanding prolonged exposure to temperatures up to 227°C without compromising its structural integrity or performance. This filament remains reliable and robust in extreme environments, making it perfect for industrial, mechanical, or automotive parts that must tolerate ultra-high temperatures.

PPS-CF boasts a heat deflection temperature of up to 264°C under 0.45 MPa and can continuously operate at temperatures exceeding 200°C. This significantly outperforms normal PA-CF materials, which have maximum temperatures around 190°C and 120°C. Its exceptional heat resistance ensures outstanding creep resistance, making PPS-CF ideal for demanding industrial environments and applications.

Unmatched Mechanical Properties

context.title: PPS-CF
context.near: Combining the stiffness of PPS polymers with the reinforcing power of carbon fiber, PPS-CF offers exceptional stiffness, bending strength, and tensile strength.

strings.en: Combining the stiffness of PPS polymers with the reinforcing power of carbon fiber, PPS-CF offers exceptional stiffness, bending strength, and tensile strength. Its superior dimensional stability and resistance to warping ensure that large-scale prints maintain precision and avoid deformation during the printing process, making it perfect for high-precision applications.

PPS-CF offers outstanding solvent and chemical resistance, second only to PTFE (Teflon). It remains virtually insoluble in any solvent below 200°C and exhibits exceptional resistance to acids, bases, and salts under normal conditions. This makes PPS-CF the ideal choice for challenging environments where chemical stability is critical.

With an extremely low moisture absorption rate of just 0.05%, PPS-CF ensures that its mechanical and thermal properties remain stable even in humid conditions. Unlike normal PA-CF, which can soften and degrade when exposed to moisture, PPS-CF maintains its strength and durability, making it the superior option for applications requiring high moisture resistance.

Engineered for real-world impact, Bambu PLA Tough+ delivers toughness on par with ABS and offers up to 2× stronger layer adhesion than standard PLA. It shrugs off bumps, drops, and hits, making it ideal for RC cars, model planes, and durable tools.
Designed for repeated flexing, Bambu PLA Tough+ outlasts standard PLA where it typically fails. It’s perfect for prints that need to bend without breaking—like springs, clips, and connectors.

With enhanced durability, Bambu PLA Tough+ maintains its performance over time, extending the lifespan of standard PLA prints and making it suitable for demanding, tool-grade applications. Use it for parts that need impact resistance and repeated flexing.
2.Ventilation Tips
Due to the higher printing temperature, PLA Tough+ has a slightly stronger, non-pungent odor than regular PLA when melting. If necessary, lower the printing temperature or maintain ventilation.
4.Support Recommendations

Due to the high interlayer strength of Bambu PLA Tough+, it is recommended to use dedicated support filaments (Bambu Support for PLA, or Bambu Support for PLA/PETG) as the support interface material for easier removal and a cleaner finish..

Multi-Material Printing with Less Waste

context.title: H2C Induction Hotend (Right)
context.near: The Vortek System uses up to six interchangeable induction-heated hotends to achieve true multi-material printing with significantly reduced purge waste compare

strings.en: The Vortek System uses up to six interchangeable induction-heated hotends to achieve true multi-material printing with significantly reduced purge waste compared to single-nozzle systems. The hotend swap mechanism eliminates purge flushing during filament changes (H2C under 7 filaments), saving both material and time.
Fast and Precise Induction Heating

context.title: H2C Induction Hotend (Right)
context.near: The Vortek Induction Hotend rapidly heats the nozzle to printing temperature in approximately 8 seconds (PLA). This fast response shortens color-change transiti

strings.en: The Vortek Induction Hotend rapidly heats the nozzle to printing temperature in approximately 8 seconds (PLA). This fast response shortens color-change transitions and further reduces purge waste. Integrated overheat, overvoltage, short-circuit, and open-circuit protection ensure reliable performance during continuous multi-material workflows.
Reliable Contactless Connection

context.title: H2C Induction Hotend (Right)
context.near: Instead of contact-based metal pins—which can oxidize and degrade over time—the Vortek System employs a contactless, high-frequency power and signal interface.

strings.en: Instead of contact-based metal pins—which can oxidize and degrade over time—the Vortek System employs a contactless, high-frequency power and signal interface. This delivers a stable, long-lasting connection for accurate temperature control and synchronized hotend operation.
Heatsink Overheat Monitoring

context.title: H2C Induction Hotend (Right)
context.near: Dual temperature sensors monitor both nozzle and heatsink temperatures in real time. When heatsink temperature exceeds safe limits, the system automatically inc

strings.en: Dual temperature sensors monitor both nozzle and heatsink temperatures in real time. When heatsink temperature exceeds safe limits, the system automatically increases cooling to prevent heat creep and reduce the risk of clogging.
Intelligent Multi-Hotend Management

context.title: H2C Induction Hotend (Right)
context.near: Each Vortek Hotend stores its filament information locally, ensuring correct material mapping and preventing loading errors. When printing with more than seven

strings.en: Each Vortek Hotend stores its filament information locally, ensuring correct material mapping and preventing loading errors. When printing with more than seven filament types, the system intelligently optimizes hotend mapping to minimize purge waste and improve overall efficiency.

Need some extra pizazz for your prints? Bambu 3D Effect Plate can transfer interesting surface textures to your printed objects. There are 4 exciting textures, ranging from Carbon Fiber all the way to Starry, Galaxy, and Diamond! Want to make your prints stand out? Get Bambu 3D Effect Plate and unlock a world of textural possibilities!

1. Before printing with any filament, it is recommended to apply glue on the Engineering Plate. Applying solid glue can make part removal easier, but since solid glue has a certain thickness and is difficult to apply evenly, the printing stability and first-layer quality are usually not as good as when using liquid glue. On the other hand, liquid glue may make part removal more difficult. You should choose the appropriate glue type based on the filament, printing environment, and other practical conditions. For more details, please refer to the official wiki: Bambu Lab Wiki.

2. When using a scraper to remove prints, make sure to use the correct technique. If the model adheres too tightly to the build plate, apply alcohol to the interface between the model and the plate to reduce adhesion and make removal easier. This helps prevent damage to the model, the build plate, or potential injury to the user caused by excessive force.

strings.en: Printing TPU has traditionally been a challenge due to the filament's inherent elasticity and high friction. To ensure a smooth extrusion, the feed path must be as short and direct as possible. The TPU Feed Assist Module eliminates the struggle by providing an active, consistent push to the filament. By stabilizing the feed and reducing drag, it delivers the reliability and precision required for professional-grade TPU results.

context.title: Filament Track Switch
context.near: Dual-extrusion 3D printers significantly accelerate multi-color printing by reducing the flushing time required by single-extrusion machines. Traditionally, ens

strings.en: Dual-extrusion 3D printers significantly accelerate multi-color printing by reducing the flushing time required by single-extrusion machines. Traditionally, ensuring filaments reached the correct nozzle required manually swapping spools between AMS units. With the Filament Track Switch, those days are over. It intelligently routes any filament from your AMS units to whichever nozzle the slicer assigns, giving you total hardware flexibility and faster prints.

context.near: The filament track switch unbinds the AMS from specific nozzles, allowing any filament to feed into any nozzle regardless of configuration. This enables dynamic

strings.en: The filament track switch unbinds the AMS from specific nozzles, allowing any filament to feed into any nozzle regardless of configuration. This enables dynamic filament mapping, permitting mid-print color reassignments that significantly boost multi-color efficiency.

1. After installing the Filament Track Switch, the number of AMS units that can be connected depends on the printer's supported AMS expansion limit. Please refer to the official specifications of the corresponding printer model for details.

2. For dual-nozzle printers (such as the X2D), a single AMS can still support dual-nozzle printing and enable filament switching between the left and right hotends when used with the Filament Track Switch. However, when only one AMS is connected, the left and right hotends support alternate feeding only, not simultaneous feeding. During switching, the AMS must first unload the filament and then reload it.

The control board fan is used to cool the control board to prevent the control board from overheating and shutting down. The control board fan cannot be manually controlled, and the printer automatically adjusts the speed.
The chamber temperature regulator fan is used to control the temperature and to help filter air inside the chassis.
4800 rpm/min

The Chamber Temperature Regulator Fan is responsible for adjusting the temperature within the chamber. The fan operates based on the detected chamber temperature, determining both its on/off status and the speed at which it operates.

The cooling fan is used for cooling and reducing the temperature of the ceramic heater for hotend. The AMS Feeder Unit is specially designed to support the AMS for printing multiple colors and materials. Each AMS has 4 feeder units, and each feeder unit has its own motor and gears to actively push the filament forward or wind it back to the spool. The AMS Feeder Unit has a sensor to detect filament. When a filament is inserted, the feeder unit will pull the filament automatically. When a filament needs to be winded back, the feeder unit will drive the AMS driving sleeve to rotate the spool for filament winding.

The Bambu Hardened Steel Extruder Gear Assembly is one of the components of the Bambu Hardened Steel Extruder Unit. Consisting of the driven gear and the active gear, the extruder gear assembly can feed filament into the hotend. Although it is constructed with heavy-duty parts for a long service life, the extruder gear assembly can be replaced if abrasion happens after long-term use. It's not only suitable for feeding common 3D printing filaments, but also for feeding engineering filaments like carbon fiber nylon, glass fiber nylon, etc.
Learn more about the replacement of hardened steel extruder gear on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The hardened steel extruder gear assembly is an internal component of the hardened steel extruder unit. It comprises a driven gear and an active gear that work together to feed filament into the hotend.

Built with heavy-duty materials, the hardened steel extruder gear has a better capability of printing with tough engineering filaments like PAHT-CF and PET-CF for long-lasting performance. If abrasion or clogging occurs due to extended use, users can just replace the extruder gear assembly rather than the whole extruder unit.

The AMS lite Feeder Unit is specially designed to support the AMS lite for printing multiple colors and materials. Due to its unique symmetrical design, the feeder unit is designed in both left and right versions. Both left and right feeder units have their corresponding slots. The left feeder unit corresponds to Slot 1 and Slot 2, while the right feeder unit corresponds to Slot 3 and Slot 4.

The left and right feeder units have only minor structural differences, while their functionality and purpose remain identical. Please note that both the left and right feeder units can only be installed in their respective positions. Please confirm that you have selected the correct version (left or right) before purchase.

strings.en: Learn more about the replacement of the Heatbed Unit V3 - P1 Series on Bambu Lab Wiki.
Heatbed Unit V3*1

The heatbed in the P1 series printer is a platform installed inside the printer chamber. It can move up and down along the Z-axis and can be heated based on the temperature set by the user. Setting an appropriate heat bed temperature can enhance model adhesion to the build plate, preventing warping.
Learn more about the replacement of the Heatbed Unit V3 - X1 Series on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The heatbed in the X1 series printer is a platform installed inside the printer chamber. It can move up and down along the Z-axis and can be heated based on the temperature set by the user. Setting an appropriate heat bed temperature can enhance model adhesion to the build plate, preventing warping.
Please refer to the Wiki page here to check the version of your X1 Series Heatbed Unit.
The X1 series printers currently have both Heatbed Unit V3 and V2 heatbed options. All printers will eventually shift to the V3 heatbed.

AP Board - X1 Series

AP Board refers to the Application board, it is a circuit board that controls the interaction of information within the unit. It provides a self-contained operating environment that delivers all system capabilities needed to support the printer's applications, including memory management, system firmware, graphics processing and multimedia decoding.

1. The AP board might need replacement in cases of abnormal voltages, components abnormally hot, burnt out, unrecoverable system failure, or firmware upgrade failure. Some of these can be detected through the log file which is sent to customer support.

Learn more about the Extruder Switch Cam on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The extruder switching system operates through a switching motor and transmission mechanism that drives the Extruder Switch Cam. This action causes the left and right driven wheel linkages (driven rods) to swing. A tension spring, attached to the driven rod, ensures that one driven wheel is pressed firmly against the drive wheel, enabling filament extrusion as the drive wheel rotates. Simultaneously, the opposite driven wheel remains disengaged, preventing unwanted filament movement.
By reversing the drive wheel's rotation, the extruder motor can selectively engage either driven wheel, enabling seamless dual extrusion using a single drive wheel.

The AMS 2 Pro Internal Hub Unit is specially designed for Bambu AMS 2 Pro, which is located at the rear of AMS 2 Pro and consists of four Hall sensors, a magnetic rotary encoder, and a motor. It merges four filament slots into one and is used to select particular filaments in AMS 2 Pro and convey filaments from AMS 2 Pro to the printer. The Hall sensor detects when the filament reaches a specific position and activates the brushless motor to provide an additional driving force for feeding the filament.

Learn more about the AMS 2 Pro Air Inlet Unit on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The AMS 2 Pro has two active inlet and outlet air vent, with the bottom one as the outlet and the rear one as the intlet. The dampers in the Outlet (bottom) Unit and Inlet (side wall) Unit assemblies are identical, differing only in cable length.

When drying the filament, AMS 2 Pro will discharge moisture from the inside through external circulation. When performing external circulation, the air inlet and outlet will be opened. Please ensure that they are not obstructed by other debris to achieve the best drying performance.

The Induction Hotend Dock Assembly is the positioning detection unit for the hotend assembly. It uses magnetic adsorption to ensure stable placement of the hotend and integrates a Hall sensor and indicator light — the Hall sensor detects whether the hotend is correctly positioned, while the indicator light provides real-time feedback on the hotend's status.
M3x14 Screw

The Induction Heating Assembly - Right is the core functional module that enables non-contact rapid heating of the hotend. It features an integrated induction coil that generates eddy currents inside the hotend assembly through electromagnetic induction, allowing for fast temperature rise. Additionally, the module incorporates a temperature acquisition interface and a Hall sensor to facilitate temperature data transmission and detect the installation status of the hotend.

The Induction Hotend Latch enables quick locking and unlocking of the hotend assembly. It integrates miniature magnets that work with the Hall sensor on the heating module, allowing the printer to automatically detect whether the hotend is in the locked or released state.

The Induction Hotend Rack Control Board is the core control unit of the Vortek system, responsible for centralized motion control and high-precision status feedback. It integrates a drive circuit that precisely controls the rack motor, enabling automatic pickup and placement of the hotend assembly. Additionally, it processes feedback signals from the hotend docking unit and the homing Hall sensor to ensure accurate hotend positioning and rack alignment calibration.
Learn more about the replacement of Induction Hotend Rack Frame on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The Induction Hotend Rack Frame serves as the mechanical foundation of the entire system, providing high rigidity and precise mounting references for securing the Induction Hotend Control Board, docking components, and motors. It ensures long-term geometric stability of the system during frequent hotend switching and high-speed motion.
Learn more about the replacement of Induction Hotend Rack Belt Assembly on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The Induction Hotend Rack Belt Assembly is the power transmission core of the Vortek system. It transfers the rotational motion generated by the 3513 Induction Hotend Rack Motor into precise linear lifting motion of the induction hotend rack.

The 3513 Induction Hotend Rack Motor is a servo motor responsible for driving the lifting movement of the rack. It provides stable and reliable torque output with intelligent adjustment capabilities, automatically modulating torque or triggering an HMS alarm in case of obstruction or abnormal motion, ensuring the safety and precision of the hotend lifting operation.

Bambu Lab Cleaning Wipes are disposable wipes designed specifically for 3D printers, used for the regular cleaning and maintenance of various printer models, covering cleaning, dust removal, stain removal, and disinfection. Main ingredients include non-woven fabric, water, ethanol, surfactant, and isomeric polyol, etc.

When to Use: If key components of the printer are not cleaned for a long time, dirt will build up and cause mechanical wear or other potential issues. This not only affects the accuracy of AI detection and sensors, but also prevents the printer from operating at high precision and stability. Therefore, we recommend using Bambu Lab cleaning wipes regularly to wipe the relevant parts of your printer.

This pinball machine is a unique hybrid project that combines two different technologies: laser cutting/engraving and 3D printing, bringing to life a retro-style game inspired by the world of Pac-Man. The base and playfield are made of 3mm basswood plywood, laser-cut for precise shapes and engraved details directly on the surface. The engravings include decorative writings such as PINBALL, RUN, and GAME OVER, as well as iconic shapes of Pac-Man and the ghosts, enriching the playfield with a nostalgic style. Just click here to get the assembly guide.
The result is a completely mechanical game, without electronics, that combines craftsmanship, retro design, and modern technologies, offering a gaming experience that is both simple and fascinating.
The ball launching system is located on the right side and can be operated manually.
The steel balls are stored in the front compartment engraved with GAME OVER.

strings.en: For 3D printed parts, which often have gaps between layers and varying hole sizes, we recommend using BT self-tapping screws. These screws provide moderate torque for insertion, prevent loosening, and can be installed and removed multiple times. Using these screws and matching them with the recommended hole size ensures easy and secure connections for your printed parts, eliminating the need for nuts and avoiding issues like screw loosening or hole shrinkage.

The N20 Reduction Gear Motor is a low-power reduction motor with a D-shaped output shaft, suitable for applications requiring continuous rotation of objects. This motor offers three speed options, including a low-speed version (150rpm), a medium-speed (400rpm), and a high-speed (1000rpm). The motor can be connected to the Power Distribution Board (PDB) with 4 Channels using the Wire Pair with SH1.0-2PIN-5CM/10CM/20CM.
Please use a power supply within the working voltage range.
Avoid immersing the motor in water or getting the motor wet.

strings.en: Discover our high-quality black nylon cord, neatly stored for your convenience. Durable and strong, it's perfect for all crafting levels, ensuring lasting use and reliability in your projects.

Nylon rope is a highly durable and versatile material widely used in 3D printing models. It can be used to connect and secure different parts, providing reliable mechanical strength and flexibility, especially for complex models that require flexible connections. In addition, the flexibility and high-quality material properties of this nylon rope allow it to withstand prolonged stress without deforming or breaking, making it ideal for use in 3D printed components that need to be moved or movable, such as joints, pulley systems, and adjustable sections.

context.title: Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit

strings.en: The Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit is a multifunctional toolkit specifically designed for handheld props, combining lighting, sound, and motion-sensing controls to deliver a personalized, immersive experience. Featuring high-brightness LED strips paired with diffused pearl cotton, it offers smooth and natural lighting effects. An integrated speaker cavity ensures clear audio quality, while the built-in IMU motion sensor captures real-time movements, triggering corresponding light and sound effects for actions like turning on/off, swinging, thrusting, or striking.

context.title: Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit

strings.en: The Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit offers two configurations: Kit 01 (Complete Set with LED strips, aluminum alloy tubes, and diffused pearl cotton for large-scale props like the Golden Staff) and Kit 02 (Compact Edition requiring user-provided LED light strip 256RGB 5050LED 815MM, optimized for swords/daggers). Unlike purely aesthetic prop sets that lack hardware, this kit is more than just a prop—it's your creative partner. It supports extensive customization across appearance, lighting effects, and sound effects, compatible with various prop forms such as Golden Staff, Double-Bladed Weapon, and Pixel Lightsaber. Leveraging 3D printing and professional design, it unlocks limitless possibilities for your imagination. With app connectivity, users can easily adjust light colors, flashing frequencies, and even upload custom sound and light effects, creating a one-of-a-kind, personalized prop with ease.

The Single-Axis Joystick Module is a 1-channel analog input module. It automatically returns to the center position. Compared to a Dual-Axis Joystick Module, the single-axis joystick moves in only one direction and outputs a single analog signal, making it ideal for use as a control lever in various scenarios that require speed control or position control with automatic centering — especially when the control logic of these motions needs to remain independent.

strings.en: Momentary button module is a binary input module. Different signals can be sent by short press, long press, press and lift and other actions. Compared to a three-position rocker switch module, a momentary button module has only two states: pressed and flicked up, and it always returns to flicked up. The momentary button module can be used to switch between various modes in a specified order, trigger and stop some actions in real time. For example, triggering a shot on a model with a shooting mechanism, or switching the mode and color of lights on a model with RGB lights.

At its core is a printable dual differential drivetrain paired with a robust body-on-frame chassis, delivering true Four Wheel Drive performance that can handle sand, grass, gravel, and more.

Bring Your Miniatures to Life — Without Wires.

Traditional miniature lighting often requires visible wires, complex routing, and limited placement options. The Wireless Inductive Lighting Kit delivers power wirelessly through electromagnetic induction, allowing your models to light up naturally and cleanly — without exposed cables. Perfect for dioramas, vehicles, architectural scenes, and creative DIY projects.

strings.en: Excalibur is a fantasy-inspired tabletop puzzle experience that combines 3D printing with simple electronics to create a fully interactive escape-room-style challenge. Designed as a sequential puzzle journey, each solved mechanism unlocks the next. Hidden interactions, mechanical triggers, and subtle clues guide the player deeper into the stone structure — until the final secret is revealed: a hidden drawer opened by the sword, ready to hold your own personal gift.
Plates
Dynamic Movement & Unlocking

context.title: Excalibur - The Puzzle
context.near: Engage with the puzzle's moving parts. Rotate segments, slide hidden panels, and manipulate the ancient mechanisms. Every action brings you closer to the sword,

strings.en: Engage with the puzzle's moving parts. Rotate segments, slide hidden panels, and manipulate the ancient mechanisms. Every action brings you closer to the sword, eventually unlocking a hidden drawer — a special compartment where you can place a personal gift, message, or reward, turning the puzzle into a unique and memorable experience for friends and family.
Exquisite Appearance & Lighting Design

context.title: Excalibur - The Puzzle
context.near: Observe the weathered stone texture and subtle green moss details that give the puzzle an aged, mystical appearance. The central rock housing Excalibur glows wi

Easy Start, Satisfying Finish

The German Bundeswehr usualy operated the Waffenträger’s 20mm along with a TOW variant. Creating a duo that easily could take down the lightest and heaviest targets with ease. The models are made to be fully compatible with the MakerWorld Crowdfunded 1A1 and 1A2 TOW for a complete squadron.
Crowdfunded 1A1 and 1A2 TOW

CyberBrick Mk20 & 1A4 brings one of the smallest German weapon carrier to life in a highly detailed 1/16 scale RC build. The compact hull, functional tracks, working lights, and articulated main gun give it the right mix between scale-model realism and hands-on movement. Two distinct variants show its early life form the 1980’s to its recent combat readiness in the 2000’s. Its small footprint and big character make it a fascinating build for young and old with enough mechanical detail to make the build as rewarding as possible.
Build for Historical Accuracy

context.title: CyberBrick Mk20 & 1A4 Waffenträger
context.near: Designed for the ultimate display of historical accuracy, the 1/16 scale model was built upon extensive 3D scans and reference photography form the "Deutsches P

strings.en: Designed for the ultimate display of historical accuracy, the 1/16 scale model was built upon extensive 3D scans and reference photography form the "Deutsches Panzermuseum Munster", setting new standards for accuracy and scale fidelity.
Tiny Size, Big Impact

strings.en: The small Waffenträger looks almost impossibly small parked between the running gear of a Leopard main battle tank. However, the extensive details make it look like a proper airborne warrior instead of a generic mini tank.

Available in two iconic variants:
The original Mk20 entered production late in the Cold War；

Kliko Truck Platform is a modular 3D-printable RC truck chassis built for makers who want a functional cargo hauler, not a shelf-only model. Its 1:20 scale balances usable electronics space with parts that remain practical to print at home. Build it in 6x4 or 4x2 form, add working lights, cargo bodies, and control hardware, then keep growing it through the broader CyberBrick ecosystem.
Real Hauling Play

context.title: Modular Truck Platform - CyberBrick RC
context.near: Cargo bodies mount directly to the chassis, so your build becomes a working hauler instead of a static display piece. Printable accessories let you stage loads,

strings.en: Cargo bodies mount directly to the chassis, so your build becomes a working hauler instead of a static display piece. Printable accessories let you stage loads, create routes, and keep expanding the truck after the base build is finished.
Customizable lighting

context.title: Modular Truck Platform - CyberBrick RC
context.near: The CyberBrick app allows for customizing LED lights, enhancing realism and visual appeal during operation. Integrated lighting support adds practical feedback.

strings.en: The CyberBrick app allows for customizing LED lights, enhancing realism and visual appeal during operation. Integrated lighting support adds practical feedback. It also gives the truck a more complete RC feel without relying on fragile cosmetic add-ons.
Remote Trailer Moves

context.title: Modular Truck Platform - CyberBrick RC
context.near: A servo-operated coupling turns trailer handling into part of the drive, not a manual reset between runs. Hook up, drop off, and switch tasks from the controlle

strings.en: A servo-operated coupling turns trailer handling into part of the drive, not a manual reset between runs. Hook up, drop off, and switch tasks from the controller for more realistic yard work.
Drive It Your Way

context.title: Modular Truck Platform - CyberBrick RC
context.near: CyberBrick remote compatibility keeps steering, throttle, and functions in one familiar control setup. Builders can focus on tuning the truck and adding modules

strings.en: CyberBrick remote compatibility keeps steering, throttle, and functions in one familiar control setup. Builders can focus on tuning the truck and adding modules instead of inventing a control system from scratch.

CyberBrick 4WD Car turns a 3D print into a fast, hands-on RC build with real mechanical depth. Its double wishbone independent suspension and 4WD platform give makers a more capable drive than a simple display model. A combination lighting system adds separate headlight and indicator functions for a richer driving feel. Support from the Cyberbrick ecosystem make it an ideal choice for experienced model enthusiasts seeking personalized customization.
4h to assemble
Real 4WD Fun

strings.en: Four-wheel drive gives the CyberBrick 4WD Car the grip to feel like a real RC build, not a shelf model. Its compact layout is designed for faster, more responsive driving than the earlier 4x4 Mini Off-Roader platform.
Smoother Handling

strings.en: Double wishbone independent suspension helps each wheel react cleanly over uneven surfaces. That means better control, smoother movement, and a more satisfying build for anyone who cares about mechanics.
